# Unslop

Before returning user-visible prose or writing artifacts, edit the text for plain,
direct language. Preserve the meaning and technical details.

- Remove filler, chatbot phrases, decorative emojis, and excessive hedging.
- Prefer concrete verbs and active voice.
- Avoid unnecessary jargon, metaphors, forced lists, and repeated synonyms.
- Avoid em dashes, curly quotes, and title-case headings.
- Keep code, identifiers, commands, and required technical names unchanged.
